# build-preset

> Shared build conventions for browser games: a Vite 8 game config, Vitest unit and headed, muted
> real-browser test fragments (Vitest 4 or 5), a Capacitor config with documented merge rules, a tsup
> library build, and TypeScript and Biome base configs. Configuration only, with no runtime
> dependencies.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/build-preset/): the published, browsable version of
  everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, API
  overview, compatibility.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/docs/API.md): every export and
  option.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): contracts,
  module boundaries, build and packaging, intentional limits.
- [Decisions](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): why the package is
  shaped the way it is.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain, invariants not
  to violate, and doc/test sync obligations for an autonomous coding agent.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/build-preset/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup,
  the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
